test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Blessing in disguise.

options.text: Has a good effect even though at first it seemed it would be bad
When a simple solution solves a problem very well
Has a very good effect on a situation or a thing
When things get better and better when least expecting it

solution:
The correct answer is: **Has a good effect even though at first it seemed it would be bad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**a blessing in disguise**" means that something that initially seems bad or unfortunate actually turns out to have a positive outcome. (जो चीज़ शुरू में बुरी या दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण लगती है उसका वास्तव में सकारात्मक परिणाम निकलता है)

 
 
• **For example**:* Missing the train turned out to be a blessing in disguise, as it allowed her to avoid a major accident up ahead.*
 
 
 
• The phrase suggests that the blessing was not immediately apparent or obvious.
 
• This idiom is often used to describe situations where something bad happens, but it ends up leading to something good.
 
• The phrase can be traced back to a fable by Aesop, in which a man's lost horse returns with more horses, which he then sells for a profit.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2** does not accurately reflect the meaning of the idiom.
 
• **Option 3** is close in meaning, but does not convey the idea that the positive outcome was unexpected or disguised.
 
• **Option 4** is similar in meaning, but does not necessarily suggest that the initial situation was bad or unfortunate.

1b0:T838,

The correct answer is: **Objective**
